div.div: ⚠ This context is not deployed by the CDK app. There is no NotificationStack in infra/ and no matching construct. The service provisions its own queue and tables at runtime (ensureResources in resources.go), which works in the Aspire-orchestrated local environment — but means that on real AWS nothing here is created by cdk deploy. Worth deciding whether it joins the CDK or is intentionally development-only.

div.div:
Configuration via environment variables (with defaults in main.go):
SQS_QUEUE_URL — preferred, injected by Aspire; SQS_QUEUE_NAME is the lookup fallback
DYNAMODB_TABLE → duckstore-notifications · PROCESSED_EVENTS_TABLE → notification-processed-events
APP_MODE — switches between the Lambda handler and a local polling loop
